per_article_summaries: Ralf Schumacher and Etienne Bousquet-Cassagne have tied the knot in St Tropez. The former Formula 1 driver and Sky Germany analyst came out as gay in July 2024. The couple are set to appear on the Sky Germany docuseries Ralf and Étienne, We Say Yes.

McLaren fined €30,000 by the FIA for a breach of F1 regulations. Lando Norris's car halted unexpectedly at the Nouvelle Chicane. Marshals were unable to trigger the car's mandatory clutch disengagement system. McLaren admitted that they had taped over the actuating button.

The MCL-HY is the hypercar McLaren will campaign in next year's FIA World Endurance Championship. It will also serve as the foundation for an exclusive track-only car - the MCL-HY GTR - which is currently only being offered to the most important of the manufacturer's VIP client list. This is the first time since the F1 GTR's win at Le Mans in 1995 that McLaren has built a car for such a race.

Four-time Formula 1 champion Max Verstappen's Unleash The Lion is docked in Port Hercule. The 33-metre Mangusta GranSport 33 can accommodate 12 guests alongside a dedicated crew of five. Breakthrough, a 118.8-metre Feadship, is the world's first hydrogen fuel-cell-powered superyacht.

Formula 1 heads to Monaco this weekend after a dramatic Canadian Grand Prix. Kimi Antonelli claimed his fourth consecutive victory and extended his championship lead. Mercedes team-mate George Russell retired from the lead with a power unit failure. Saturday brings the final hour of preparation in FP3 before qualifying.

Mercedes and McLaren bombarded Ferrari as the pre-event favourite due to the excellent low-speed performance of its chassis. Lewis Hamilton led home hero Charles Leclerc to end the day on top in FP2, 0.168s clear of Red Bull's Max Verstappen.

Fernando Alonso has been one of the biggest critics of F1's new rules. Spaniard has been complaining about ‘random downshifts’ and ‘chronic understeer’ Aston Martin was 0.178s slower than Cadillac at the end of Friday practice.

Oscar Piastri could only manage seventh, 1.062s behind pacesetter Lewis Hamilton in the Ferrari. World champion Lando Norris was down in 19th after undiagnosed electrical issues. McLaren is still trying to figure out why Norris' car suddenly shut down.

Will Buxton believes George Russell can stop Kimi Antonelli's momentum. Russell won the season-opening Australian Grand Prix and the Chinese sprint race. Antonelli became the youngest driver in the history of F1 to lead the championship after back-to-back wins.

F1's Las Vegas Grand Prix will stay on the calendar until at least 2037. F1 signed a three-year deal in 2023, which was then extended for two more years. The event generated $43 million in state and local tax revenue in 2025 alone.

Isack Hadjar crashes out of first practice session ahead of 2026 Monaco Grand Prix. Red flag waved with just under 24 minutes remaining of the 60-minute session. Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli was top of the timesheets at the time.

Kimi Antonelli claims pole for Sunday's Monaco Grand Prix. Championship leader Max Verstappen finishes second. Lewis Hamilton will share the second row with Charles Leclerc. Lewis Hamilton was 0.177s slower than Verstappen in third.

The final practice session for the Monaco Grand Prix took place on Saturday. Jenson Button believes Max Verstappen and Mercedes will be the biggest challenge. The main race takes place on Sunday at 3pm local time (2pm UK time)

Kimi Antonelli topped the timesheet with a time of 1m12.720s in third practice session. Mercedes team-mate George Russell finished fourth, 0.763 seconds off of the Italian's time. Russell retired from the lead with an issue with his Mercedes machinery. Qualifying for the Monaco Grand Prix will take place on Saturday 6 June.

Ferrari driver Lewis Hamilton is unhappy with Ferrari's simulator. Hamilton believes it doesn't accurately replicates the real behaviour of the car. Ferrari team-mate Charles Leclerc doesn't agree. Hamilton's two best finishes this season have coincided with him eschewing the simulator.

Oliver Bearman crashes out of third and final practice session ahead of Monaco Grand Prix. Red flag waved with just under 14 minutes left on the clock of the 60-minute session. Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli was fastest at the time of the red flag.

Oscar Piastri and Lando Norris qualified seventh and eighth, over half a second off Mercedes polesitter Kimi Antonelli, which has the same engine as McLaren’s MCL40. The new front wing concept is the foundation for a whole set of developments which will iterate from it. McLaren needs to understand why real-world performance deviated from the expectations set up by its simulation tools.

Lance Stroll crashes out of Monaco Grand Prix on Lap 60. The Canadian driver crashed into the barrier in the final sector of the street circuit at Antony Noghes (Turn 19), leading to the deployment of the safety car. The late safety car gave the remaining cars on the circuit the chance to make a cheaper pitstop.

Nico Hulkenberg and Gabriel Bortoleto put the new Audi Nuvolari through its paces. The supercar is named after the pre-war racing legend Tazio Nuvolari. It is powered by a 4.0-litre biturbo V8 engine and can reach a top speed of 350 km/h.

F1's governing body the FIA measured the performance of all V6 combustion engines to determine both the benchmark power unit as well as the deficit of its competitors. Mercedes' deficit exceeds the 2% threshold, meaning it will qualify for one homologation token. Ferrari is expected to receive two tokens because it is over 4% behind.Audi and Honda are believed to be even further behind, as expected.

George Russell finished outside the points at the Monaco Grand Prix. He was lapped by team-mate Kimi Antonelli and was hit with a drive-through penalty for speeding in the pitlane. The result means Antonelli leads the championship with 156 points. Lewis Hamilton has moved into second place with 90 points.

Ferrari's Kimi Antonelli wins Monaco Grand Prix. Five-time world champion held off Lewis Hamilton. Charles Leclerc and Lance Stroll crash at final corner. Red flag at lap 66 for resurfacing of track at Antony Noghes.

Pierre Gasly claims he's been 'robbed' of a podium place after receiving two pitlane speeding penalties in Monaco Grand Prix. Alpine driver delivered one of the standout drives of the race, climbing from ninth on the grid to cross the line third. Gasly was handed two five-second penalties for pitlane speeding - one for exceeding the 60km/h limit by 0.1km/h and another by 0.4km/h. Alpine asks for a right to review the pitlane speeding penalties.

Kimi Antonelli won the 2026 Monaco Grand Prix from pole position. The 19-year-old Italian then jumped into the harbour to celebrate his victory. He has now extended his lead in the drivers' championship to 66 points. The Barcelona Grand Prix will take place on 12-14 June.

Kimi Antonelli won his fifth consecutive grand prix in Monaco. George Russell finished sixth, two points behind his Mercedes team-mate. The Briton's title deficit ballooned from 43 to 68 points. He is now two points behind Lewis Hamilton in the championship.

Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff has admitted that internal "confusion" over strategy was the root cause of the pitstop blunder that cost George Russell a potential podium finish. Russell was firmly in the mix for a top-four finish around the streets of Monte Carlo, before a costly miscommunication on the Mercedes pitwall. The 28-year-old driver was handed a drive-through penalty for not serving the first punishment.
